BJP threatens police station siege over Karnataka FIRs

Karnataka BJP President Nalin Kumar Kateel (referred to as Vijayendra in one report) has threatened to lay siege to police stations if the state government continues to file First Information Reports (FIRs) against party workers concerning "Form-7" cases. The threat comes amid ongoing political tensions in the state.
